Libraries the programs link from the MSYS2 CLANG64 packages (installed by the builder, not in this tree):
SDL3 - zlib
Vulkan loader and headers - Apache-2.0
FFmpeg (libavcodec, libavformat, libavutil, libswscale, libswresample) - LGPL-2.1-or-later when built without GPL components. The MSYS2 package the project was built and tested with is configured with --enable-gpl --enable-version3, which makes it GPL-3.0-or-later: a binary built as BUILDING.md describes can therefore only be distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later. This repository ships source only, and its own files are GPL-2.0-or-later, which GPL-3.0 allows
fmt - MIT
xxHash - BSD-2-Clause
Zydis / Zycore - MIT
Boost (headers) - BSL-1.0
Vulkan Memory Allocator and robin-map - MIT
libc++ and libunwind (LLVM runtime) - Apache-2.0 with LLVM exceptions
winpthreads (mingw-w64) - MIT-style licence of the mingw-w64 runtime
Code inside gpu/shadps4 and gpu/shim keeps the licence and copyright notice in its own file header; gpu/shadps4/LICENSE covers the rest
